comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/391698033 (Brandywine Ski Resort, landuse=winter_sports): the hill on West Highland Road at Sagamore Hills, in Cuyahoga Valley National Park, Ohio, from the tops of Lift 1, Lift 2 and the Ram Quad down to the Main Lodge, with the Progression Park, Lift 4, Lift 5 and the Handle Tow on its east side and the Polar Blast tubing park beyond, on one map (Epic, Vail Resorts); it holds every lift and run, and no part of it is reached only by shuttle or road. Boston Mills Ski Resort, the other hill on the same Epic card (bmbw.com: Boston Mills Brandywine, two resorts about 2 km apart with their own lodges, lifts and trail maps, joined by no lift or trail, so one map each by the owner's rule of 2026-11-14), is a listed neighbour (resorts.json): its polygon lies in the south-west of the box. No other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-14 against Brandywine's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_BMBW_brandywine-winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the Brandywine Trail Map bmbw.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF's painting, an image with no text layer, rendered at two and five times its size and read tile by tile), the newest the resort publishes. Its key: Easier (green circle), More Difficult (blue square), Most Difficult (black diamond; no double black), Freestyle Terrain (orange) and Slow Zone, read as OSM's easy (Frosty novice, which draws green too), intermediate and advanced; its lifts are Lift 1, Lift 2 and the Ram Quad (quad chairs), Lift 4 and Lift 5 (triple chairs), the Handle Tow and the Carpet Lift, as OSM names them with the map's occupancies, and the tubing park's two Tubing Carpet Lifts. The resort's lift and terrain status loads by script, and its mountain-info page gives Boston Mills' and Brandywine's statistics together (18 trails, 15 lifts, 3 terrain parks: 'BW offers 2 and BM offers 1', read 2026-11-14), so the printed map is the source and wins. All eleven of the map's trails are in OSM, each with the map's rating (The Park, Shredder, Grizzly, Champagne, Regulator Johnston, Downdraft, Outer Limits, Progression Park, Easy Rider, J's Way and Frosty). Names stay as OSM has them where the map differs by a space (DOWN DRAFT, as Seven Springs' Yodeler By Pass) or by its own slip (REGULARTOR JOHNSTON for Regulator Johnston). Parks: The Park and Progression Park, the map's two freestyle-terrain areas, are snow parks in OSM already. Hidden: the two Tubing Carpet Lifts of the tubing park, which serve tubing lanes, not ski runs (two ways about 2 m apart, one per carpet, as the map draws two), as Vail's, Keystone's and Seven Springs' tubing carpets are. OSM gaps: none of the map's trails or lifts is missing.

overrides.reason: Tubing Carpet Lift: one of the two conveyors of the Polar Blast tubing park beside the Tubing Lodge, which Brandywine's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_BMBW_brandywine-winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the Brandywine Trail Map bmbw.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF rendered at two and five times its size) labels TUBING CARPET LIFT in the TUBING PARK, away from the ski runs: a tubing lift, not a ski lift, hidden as Vail's, Keystone's and Seven Springs' tubing carpets are.
